name: JoAi: Notify Order Contact

title.fr: Notifier le contact de la commande

description.en: Send a branded order email to the customer contact: confirmation (with invoice when available) or a payment reminder for a pending order. Runs as the executing agent.
description.de: Sendet eine gebrandete Bestell-E-Mail an den Kundenkontakt: Bestätigung (mit Rechnung, falls vorhanden) oder Zahlungserinnerung für eine ausstehende Bestellung. Läuft als ausführender Agent.
description.fr: Envoie un e-mail de commande brandé au contact client : confirmation (avec facture si disponible) ou rappel de paiement pour une commande en attente. S'exécute via l'agent.
description.es: Envía un correo de pedido con marca al contacto del cliente: confirmación (con factura si está disponible) o recordatorio de pago para un pedido pendiente. Se ejecuta como el agente.
description.it: Invia un'email ordine brandizzata al contatto cliente: conferma (con fattura se disponibile) o promemoria di pagamento per un ordine in sospeso. Eseguito come agente.
description.ro: Trimite un email de comandă branduit către contactul client: confirmare (cu factură dacă există) sau reminder de plată pentru o comandă în așteptare. Rulează ca agentul executant.

bot: Use when the merchant wants to email the customer a branded order confirmation or payment reminder for a pending order. List orders first to resolve orderId. Prefer this over drafting a freeform contact message so branding and the pay/order link stay intact. The executing agent is used as the sender. For unpaid pending orders use type payment-reminder; otherwise use confirmation.

inputs.name: Order ID

description.en: Hash ID of the order to notify about

inputs.bot: The order hash ID. List orders first if needed.

inputs.name: Type
inputs.bot: Use confirmation for order confirmation emails. Use payment-reminder only for pending unpaid orders.

description.en: Agent UUID used as the email sender

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
